title: Wellness Membership Agreement: Term, Notice and Early-Termination Schedule
content:
Each Wellness Membership tier has its own commitment and early-termination fee; the notice, cooling-off, waiver and refund terms are common to all six tiers.

| Tier | Commitment | Early-termination fee | Written notice before a cancellation takes effect | Cooling-off period after signing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Gym Access Membership | 0 months (month to month from the start) | 0.00 | 30 calendar days | 3 business days |
| Aquatic Access Membership | 0 months (month to month from the start) | 0.00 | 30 calendar days | 3 business days |
| Wellness Essentials Membership | 3 billing periods | 79.00 | 30 calendar days | 3 business days |
| Wellness Plus Membership | 3 billing periods | 129.00 | 30 calendar days | 3 business days |
| Performance Membership | 6 billing periods | 189.00 | 30 calendar days | 3 business days |
| Performance Plus Membership | 6 billing periods | 239.00 | 30 calendar days | 3 business days |

## Terms common to all six tiers

1. **Continuation after the commitment.** Every tier continues month to month after the commitment.
2. **Relocation waiver distance.** The early-termination fee is waived for a documented new residence more than 25 miles from every Piedmont Motion clinic.
3. **Medical termination waiver.** Every tier provides for the early-termination fee to be waived on a physician's statement that the member can no longer exercise.
4. **No prorated refund.** On every tier, dues already billed for the final period are not refunded in part on cancellation.

## Definitions

- **Commitment** is the minimum number of billing periods before the member may cancel without an early-termination fee; 0 means month to month from the start.
- **Early-termination fee** is the fee for a cancellation that takes effect before the commitment ends; it is 0.00 on a tier with no commitment.
- **Cooling-off period** is the number of business days after signing within which the member may cancel for a full refund.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical)

A Performance Membership member has a commitment of 6 billing periods and an early-termination fee of 189.00; a Wellness Essentials Membership member has 3 billing periods and 79.00; an Open Gym Access Membership member has no commitment and an early-termination fee of 0.00.
